data: The caption states that the figure shows the impact of word deletion on initially correctly (left) and falsely (right) classified test sentences, using either SA or LRP as relevance decomposition methods. The legend indicates that the blue line represents 'LRPcons', which is a variant of LRP with relevance conservation. Therefore, the blue line in the left graph represents the method 'LRPcons'.
